verdict.rationale: Secureframe's user-access-review features (secureframe-docs-6,7,16,17,33,34) support confirming and revoking access at offboarding, and custom Personnel fields (secureframe-docs-25) suggest some workforce tracking, but there is no evidence of an HR-system sync or a dedicated onboarding/offboarding checklist tying training completion to access provisioning/de-provisioning. missing for 10: explicit HR-integration/sync evidence, onboarding checklist proving training completion, and offboarding checklist tied to HR termination events.
